text:
oliver_cs: FYI - Greenfield Labs (acct 4710) invoice #9177 autopay tried a virtual card and gateway returned MCC_BLOCK / `card_not_supported` on tokenization. They say treasury only uses virtual cards via their T&E platform. Need guidance: can we accept a wire instead or require vendor onboarding?

pat_fin: paste gateway response & last4 of token if available. Virtual cards sometimes get rejected for software subscriptions due to MCC filtering. If it's MCC_BLOCK we should offer wire and a one-time pay link (if they'd like).

oliver_cs: gateway log shows: `tokenization_error: mcc_blocked`, network=Visa, token_last4=7012. Attempts at 2026-04-15T08:05Z. Customer says: "Treasury issues virtual cards automatically; they can't change MCC. We'll wire if you provide beneficiary details and confirm tax docs are ok."

billing-bot: [automated] Payment-attempt: invoice=9177 customer=GreenfieldLabs method=virtual_card token_last4=7012 status=failed gateway=Adyen region=eu-west-1

evan_sales: Sales flags this as high priority pilot. They need staging access unlocked. Offer wire as primary route. Also ask if their vendor portal needs our W-9 or local tax form for wire.

sara_billing: We can accept wire. Because beneficiary country is EU and invoice currency is USD, compliance requires vendor onboarding + proof of incorporation (or W-9 for US entities). If they can't provide immediately, we can accept wire but hold access until proof of payment + vendor docs attached for finance. Waive one-time onboarding fee if delayed.

compliance-bot: Vendor onboarding status: missing docs: proof_of_incorporation OR W-9, bank_beneficiary_verification. Suggest secure channel for collecting docs.

pat_fin: Ok proceed: 1) disable auto retries for token/card, 2) create manual invoice flagged payment_method=wire, 3) send wire template and vendor onboarding checklist via secure channel, 4) once SWIFT/MT103 + onboarding doc attached, reconcile and restore access.

oliver_cs: Copying redacted wire template here (account details via secure channel):
```
Bank: EuroBridge Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: (provided securely)
SWIFT/BIC: EUBRUS33
Reference: Invoice 9177 / GreenfieldLabs
Note: include exact reference to speed reconciliation
```

evan_sales: Also prepare a one-time secure paylink (card capture) as fallback in case treasury can request a different virtual card or switch to a corporate card. Mark paylink expiry 24h and disable auto-retries.

sara_billing: I'll create manual invoice with payment_method=wire and attach vendor onboarding checklist to ticket BILL-5268. Waiving onboarding late fee for this case. Require SWIFT copy and proof_of_incorporation (or W-9) before marking paid and restoring access.

oliver_cs: Messaging customer now: asking if treasury can share incorporation doc or W-9 and confirming they'll wire by EOD CET.

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-5268 created for invoice 9177 (manual-wire / vendor-onboarding).

compliance-bot: Note added: Sensitive docs must be uploaded via secure portal. Do not post attachments in open Slack.

pat_fin: Action items: oliver_cs collect vendor docs and wire ETA (eta 6h), sara_billing create manual invoice & attach checklist, evan_sales stand by to escalate. Escalate to finance lead if not resolved within 24h.

oliver_cs: Got reply: "Treasury confirmed they'll wire and can provide incorporation doc by COB. Please send secure upload link." I'll post when they upload.

sara_billing: Thanks. Once SWIFT arrives, attach and reconcile. Restoring partial access is possible on receipt of payment proof + confirmation from finance.

oliver_cs: Will update thread with upload + SWIFT. Thanks all.
